name: Y3 · Sabah sisi
rationale: The owner found the quiet-luxury page too hard-edged ('çok bozuk, daha yumuşak olsun') and picked the softest of three soft directions. Morning mist: a light periwinkle ground that thins to white at the top of the page, white cards with a hairline and one soft shadow, round corners everywhere, one blue you can press and a paler mist blue that only decorates. Same sections, same words, same real frames — only the visual system changed.
notes: Composition: a left-aligned 1200px grid; section pills, headings and leads sit on the left column (Capabilities and Providers shift right), content below in white cards. The owner's own exception: the hero and the closing CTA are centred in a 40–44rem measure on the mist; under the hero the real frame sits in a FULL-width white card, then five pill chips carry the repository figures. Cards: #ffffff, 1px #e6eaf3, radius 24 (small items 16, buttons and chips full pills), the ONE shadow 0 12px 40px -20px rgba(27,34,48,.18) and only on cards; nested blocks (commands, code, crops) are a tint of the ground with no shadow. No glass, no blur, no dark panels — the only dark area is the inside of a terminal frame (the screenshots and the transcript block). Accent is two-toned by measurement: #3b7dd8 for large text (≥24px, or ≥19px bold), icons, dots, lines and pill decoration only (3.8:1 on the ground); #2f6ac0 (accent-text: 4.92:1 on the ground, 5.33:1 on white, 4.79:1 on a darker #f0f3f9 ground) for links, button labels, the marked headline word and small labels; filled buttons are #2f6ac0 with white text (5.33:1), hover #27599f. Text tones measured: muted 7.0:1 / 7.5:1 and faint 5.2:1 / 5.6:1 on ground / white, faint 5.0:1 on surface-2. Type: Manrope variable, display 600 with -0.025em, h2 28–36px at 600, body 16px at 400, labels 11px 600 spaced uppercase; JetBrains Mono for commands and code. Mist: the hero and CTA carry a static CSS gradient — near-white at the top into the ground, with a faint #9fb8e8 radial wash (22% alpha) — nothing animates. Images, all real: two full sextant frames (hero Device, Terminal Shot) and five crops of frames, the weather-cloud mascot exactly twice (statement line, close — the owner insists it stays), the mark twice (header, footer). Motion: no library, no entrance animations (the built page is static and renders finished state, transcript included); CSS transitions only on hover/focus (150–300ms), the Terminal frame's 2× lens on a hovered callout (500ms), all off under prefers-reduced-motion. rejected: navy+glass (r1), storm-red/Schibsted (r2), light-sky/Fraunces/full-bleed video (r3-4), C canlı motion pass (r5), K2 lacivert band + beyaz gövde/Geist (r6, 'too classic'), R3 hava haritası/IBM Plex/chart-red (r7, 'not corporate'), KB sessiz lüks/Hanken Grotesk/#f6f6f4 paper/no borders (r8-11, shipped then rejected as 'çok bozuk' — too hard, wanted softer). Owner's tells to avoid: amber, hero for its own sake, unrelated typefaces, too many lines, too angular, everything stacked down the middle (accepted only for the hero/CTA measure, by the owner's own pick). Rules found in the build, kept as rules: accent-text (#2f6ac0) sits only on the ground, white or surface-2 — on mist-soft it measures 4.41, so numerals and labels inside mist pills are ink or text-muted, never accent. --shadow-card is a load-bearing element (card/ground 1.08, border/card 1.20 — the cards separate by the shadow) and is not to be weakened; panel-hover moves only the border. Exception: the Shot.tsx callout pills float over a screenshot and carry the card shadow. terminal-faint #8b8b85 is real text (hints) at 5.2 on the ink and 4.67 on the terminal card; ink-faint was removed as dead (3.5 on the ink). The mist gradient stops are tokens (mist-top #fdfdfe, mist-mid #f9fafd), the header bar rests on mist-mid at 95%. Four values pass by a hair — text-faint on mist-soft 4.62, the og pill label 4.62, terminal-faint on the terminal card 4.67, destructive on mist-soft 4.71 — re-measure them if the ground, mist-soft or the terminal card ever darkens.
